imports_page_subtitle: Bring templates, contacts and team members over from another product.
imports_empty_body: Start from the Templates, Contacts or Team page, or upload an export here if you are not sure what it is.
imports_start_unknown_intent: That is not something this page can import.
imports_start_unknown: I have an export and I am not sure what it is
imports_run_not_found: This import could not be found. It may have been discarded.
imports_upload_hint: CSV, Excel (.xlsx) or a template export (.json)
imports_source_replace_note: To bring in a different file, start a new import from the Imports page. Replacing the file here would throw away every correction made since it was read.
imports_upload_authorize: Keep this file so I can change the column mapping and come back to this page later.
imports_upload_authorize_help: We store it with your inspection files. It is deleted with this import.
imports_upload_staff_authorize: If nothing here can read it, let someone on the support team open it and convert it.
imports_upload_staff_authorize_help: This file may contain your clients' names, email addresses and phone numbers.
imports_upload_needs_sheet: Choose which sheet holds the list.
imports_upload_needs_authorize: Agree to us keeping the file, so this import can be picked up again later.
imports_upload_needs_staff_authorize: Agree to someone on the support team opening the file, because nothing here can read it.
imports_mapping_intro: The first rows of your file are shown so you can tell the columns apart.
imports_mapping_needs_name: Choose which column holds the name.
imports_mapping_needs_email: Choose which column holds the email address.
imports_repair_not_editable: This entry cannot be corrected here. Discard the import and fix the file.
imports_repair_fix_first: Entries that still cannot be imported: {count}.
imports_invites_sent: {sent} invitations sent, {failed} could not be delivered.
imports_undo_expired: The entries this undo reads have been cleared, so it is no longer available.
imports_revert_confirm_body: Everything this import created or replaced will be taken back. Anything that cannot be taken back will be listed.
imports_abandon_confirm_body: The file you uploaded and everything prepared from it will be deleted. Nothing has been imported yet.
imports_assistance_title: Nothing here can read this file
imports_assistance_body: Let someone on the support team open it and convert it for you. You will review what they send back before anything is imported.
imports_assistance_waiting: We have your file and will convert it. You will be told when it is ready to review.
imports_unsupported_title: Nothing here can read this file
imports_unsupported_body: This import accepts a Spectora template export (JSON), or a spreadsheet saved as CSV or Excel.
imports_source_pick_legend: Which product is this export from?
imports_source_file_spectora: The .xls or .xlsx its Templates screen exports.
imports_source_file_home_inspector_pro: The .tpz or .tpzx in its Data folder.
imports_source_file_csv_generic: Any .csv or .xlsx whose first row names the columns.
imports_source_read_here: Read as soon as you upload it. Stay on this page while it reads.
imports_source_read_by_person: Nothing here reads this format yet, so someone on the support team converts it by hand: confirmed within 2 working days, back with you within 10.
imports_source_read_by_nobody: Nothing here reads this format yet, and this deployment has no one to hand it to. Export a spreadsheet from it instead, or build the template here.
imports_start_needs_source: Say which product this export came from.
imports_mapping_template_needs_name: Give the imported template a name.
imports_mapping_ratings_severity: They say how serious a problem is
imports_mapping_ratings_severity_help: Every item keeps them, and an inspector picks one as he works.
imports_mapping_ratings_choices_help: Every item becomes a list of these answers to pick from.
imports_mapping_ratings_none_help: Every item becomes a box to type into.
imports_mapping_ratings_hint: Statutory codes such as I / NI / NP / D are the second kind.
imports_preview_intro: The counts on the last step add up whatever the conversion did. This is where you can see whether it worked.
imports_preview_none: No problems found in the structure.
imports_preview_all_plain: All of this template's items came through as plain text boxes, so there is nothing to rate on any of them.
imports_preview_most_plain: Most of this template's items came through as plain text boxes, so there is nothing to rate on them.
imports_preview_some_plain: {count} items came through as plain text boxes while the rest kept something to pick from.
imports_preview_empty_sections: Sections that came through with nothing in them: {names}
imports_preview_dropped_lead: Entries the conversion could not bring over:
imports_preview_warnings_lead: What the conversion had to decide for you:
imports_preview_aftercare_ratings: Open one item in the editor and check its ratings read the way you expect.
imports_preview_aftercare_comments: Imported comments land under Information unless the file said which tab they belong to.
imports_preview_aftercare_order: Sections keep the order they had in the file. Reorder them in the editor.
imports_pdf_blank_body: Send a template with no inspection in it. A finished report carries a client, an address and a signature, and this upload will refuse it.
imports_pdf_blank_how: The step is the same in every product: open the template in your current software, then print or export it to PDF before entering any inspection.
imports_pdf_statement: I am uploading a template with no inspection in it, and I have removed any personal information from it.
imports_pdf_upload_hint: A PDF, printed from a template you have not filled in.
imports_pdf_scan_clean_headline: No personal information was detected by our checks.
imports_pdf_scan_clean_limit: This check is not a guarantee that the file contains no personal information. You are responsible for removing personal information before upload.
imports_pdf_scan_found_headline: This file has not been accepted.
imports_pdf_scan_found_intro: Something on these pages reads as personal information. Remove it and upload the file again.
imports_pdf_scan_withheld: The page and the kind are all that is reported. The text that matched is not shown here and is not written to any log.
